short_bio: Italian fashion entrepreneur who built a business from her blog The Blonde Salad.
biography:
Chiara Ferragni was born in Cremona, Italy. In October 2009 she started the fashion blog The Blonde Salad with her then-boyfriend Riccardo Pozzoli.

The blog grew into a business, and her footwear line, the Chiara Ferragni Collection, became its main earner. She also collaborated with established houses, including a collection for Tod’s.

She married the rapper Fedez in 2018.
